validation_scope: Independent NumPy versus actual D3D11 compute output; numerical graph correctness for one seed, not a perceptual realism claim

provenance.training_data: FaceVerse textured scans of real people
provenance.license_status: No explicit code/weights license found in the public repository or model archive; local research evaluation only; redistribution rights not established
provenance.export: Learned inference tensors only; no FLAME template vertices, faces, regressors or landmark tables; no photographs, scans or training-example latent tables
provenance.runtime_input: Seed-derived shape256/detail128/color256 latent codes and 3D coordinates; canonical appearance uses zero pose controls; four captured-expression PCA curves deform the generated surface each frame
limitations: Cinematic photorealism is not established by numerical graph validation
Surface color is learned RGB, not independently verified relightable PBR albedo
Four expression modes retain 86.2354% of source variation; canonical normals are not corrected per expression
Accurate jaw/eye transforms and physical facial tissues are not implemented

motion.source: IMavatar yufeng_1812 fitted sequence distributed with GANHead
motion.interpretation: Centered captured expression variations projected onto four PCA modes; source identity-fitting mean omitted; no invented semantic meaning assigned to PCA modes
motion.jaw: relative axis-angle stored separately; not included in expression PCA

geometry_pipeline.runtime_input: Seed and generated 3D coordinates; embedded learned network parameters
geometry_pipeline.surface_extraction: Marching tetrahedra with shared edge vertices
geometry_pipeline.component_filter: Largest connected component by vertex count, before bounds normalization and surface-attribute inference
geometry_pipeline.normalization: Uniform scale to 0.33 metres high; minimum Y translated to zero; X/Z origin retained

integration_limits: Largest-component filtering can remove real disconnected parts as well as generated floaters.
Uniform bounds normalization is not a fitted skeletal registration.
Numerical correctness does not establish anatomical realism or artifact-free pose deformation.
Learned RGB may contain photographic illumination; it is not verified relightable PBR albedo.
Four learned expression directions retain a limited subspace; jaw/eye bone transforms are not applied and canonical normals are unchanged during expressions.
Head is attached at body-local Y=1.42m, body clipped above Y=1.44m; this is an authored seam rather than learned body/head correspondence.
Five predicted head skin weights are verified but renderer follows the body's head bone as a whole.

morphology.control_format: Two float4 records per frame: four expression coefficients; relative jaw axis-angle XYZ plus padding
morphology.interpolation: Linear in the vertex shader; whole loop duration is authored, not a claim about source capture frame rate
morphology.measurement_scope: All stored coefficients times every generated vertex's learned four displacement directions, before global head articulation
